text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp begins. Zenno Rob Roy still 
feels the lingering heat of the Nippon 
Derby. Yet—the Kikuka Sho awaits.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The stage where only 'the strongest' 
prevail. Steeling her resolve, Zenno Rob 
Roy requested rigorous and grueling 
training.
